input_header.description:
Hydrogen-Oxygen submechanism extracted from GRI-Mech 3.0.
Modified from the original to include N2.

Redlich-Kwong coefficients are based on tabulated critical properties or
estimated according to the method of Joback and Reid, "Estimation of pure-
component properties from group-contributions," Chem. Eng. Comm. 57 (1987)
233-243

spectra.note: total = SVD of W J; transverse = SVD of (I - Q Q^T) W J with Q an orthonormal basis of the scaled constant-control tangent span at the SAME endpoint; manifold leakage = SVD of (I - N N^T) W J with N the conserved-manifold tangent space null(C W^-1). A transverse direction below the leakage floor or below the noise discrepancy is NOT evidence of off-family state generation.
